title: Claude Opus 4.8: What's New and Why Developers Should Care
summary: Claude Opus 4.8 launches with effort control, 3x cheaper fast mode, dynamic workflows, and Messages API mid-task updates. Same $5/$25 per million token pricing.
body_markdown: Dynamic workflows let Claude write orchestration scripts that run tens to hundreds of parallel subagents, verify outputs, and surface a single answer. They work with Claude Code and are available for Max, Team, and Enterprise plans. They work best with Opus 4.8 for extended, complex tasks. See the[full dynamic workflows guide →](https://blink.new/blog/claude-code-dynamic-workflows)
